description: A compatibility-preserving diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec. DiagnosisProbe(view, device).run_full_diagnosis(train_loader) returns metrics and metric_definitions derived from the trained recommender and available public data. Probes must remain valid when the architecture changes.
motivation: Support model diagnosis and iterative improvement while preserving the benchmark contract, preventing unsupported behavioral claims, and selecting models using comparable validation results.
implementation_notes: Retain the required class and method signatures. Access the actual trained module through view.model and maintain or adapt view.item_emb, log2feats, predict_score, user_train, meta_data, and review_data. Batches contain (None, sequence, positive, negative), with tensors shaped B × L. Use only interaction histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps; mark unavailable information as unobserved. Generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for 20 real training users, five per category. Preserve all four datasets and routing. Select models by macro-average validation HR@10 under the pinned evaluator; diagnostic metrics are supplementary. Architecture changes must also update the predictor writer.
pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe:
    init(view, device): store view and device
    run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
        save model training state
        set view.model to evaluation mode
        without gradients:
            inspect batches through architecture-compatible view methods
            compute diagnostics supported by observed data
            attach definitions and availability information
        restore model training state
        return metrics, metric_definitions

For each category:
    generate full-catalog recommendations excluding seen items
    for five selected real training users
Evaluate candidate models using pinned validation HR@10
Select using the mean HR@10 across all four categories

originality.positive: Combines architecture-aware diagnostics with explicit data-availability constraints and a shared evaluation contract.
originality.negative: Primarily an integration specification; it introduces no new recommendation algorithm or diagnostic estimator.

future_potential.positive: Could support comparable diagnostics across model architectures and guide targeted improvements.
future_potential.negative: Its value depends on the diagnostic measures implemented and whether they predict validation improvements; neither is established here.

code_difficulty.positive: The fixed interface and batch shapes make the adapter straightforward to integrate with SASRec.
code_difficulty.negative: Architecture changes require careful compatibility updates, and full-catalog scoring must handle memory use, item routing, and seen-item exclusion.
